fields.title: ODPIC registry filing record
fields.description: Raw-passthrough dataset envelope. Every record carries _input/_source/_scrapedAt (and _error/_errorDetail on failures). A successful record is one filing from ODPIC's public 'publication_registre' Registre du Commerce et des Societes feed, with WordPress CMS/hypermedia scaffolding stripped and title.rendered unwrapped -- see CRAWLING_METHOD.md.

_input.title: Input
_input.description: The exact query (name) that produced this record, or '(latest)' when browsing the register without a name filter.

_source.title: Source strategy
_source.description: S1-odpic-rest (the only strategy this actor uses), or 'none' on an error record.

_scrapedAt.title: Scraped at
_scrapedAt.description: UTC ISO 8601 timestamp when this record was scraped.

_error.title: Error
_error.description: Present only on failed extractions -- not_found (query/date range matched no filings) or blocked_or_transient (network/upstream issue).

_errorDetail.title: Error detail
_errorDetail.description: Free-form diagnostic detail, present only alongside _error.

id.title: WordPress post ID
id.description: ODPIC's internal numeric ID for this filing publication.

title.title: Filing title
title.description: The registered company/establishment name as published (e.g. 'ETABLISSEMENT TAREK WAGDALLE'). Unwrapped from upstream's title.rendered.

link.title: Public URL
link.description: The public, bookmarkable ODPIC page for this filing publication.

date.title: Publication date
date.description: The date ODPIC published this filing (confirmed on samples to match registration_date/filing_date).

file_nbr.title: File number
file_nbr.description: ODPIC's RCS file number for this filing.

file_ser.title: File series (year)
file_ser.description: The filing year/series the file number belongs to.

registration_date.title: Registration date
registration_date.description: The date this entity/name was registered on the RCS.

filing_date.title: Filing date
filing_date.description: The date this specific filing was recorded.

main_owner_person_nbr.title: Owner person number
main_owner_person_nbr.description: ODPIC's internal person number for the filing's main owner.

person_name.title: Owner name
person_name.description: Full name of the filing's main owner/proprietor.

addresses.title: Address
addresses.description: Free-text address on file for this filing. Often empty -- reflects what ODPIC has on record, not a scraping gap.

disclaimers.title: Disclaimers / declared capital
disclaimers.description: Free-text field that in practice holds the declared share capital for company filings (e.g. '10 000 FDJ'). Often empty for sole-trader filings -- upstream's own field name, kept verbatim.

overview.title: Overview
overview.description: Key columns for browsing registry filings.
